stats.fact: BeHive produces 267-574 claims per research mission with average quality scores of 0.759-0.821
BeHive deploys 8-layer stealth drone evasion stack bypassing Cloudflare, DataDome, Akamai, and paywalls
BeHive integrates 70+ API sources across 37 categories including arXiv, SEC EDGAR, GitHub, PubMed, and patent databases
BeHive costs ~$0.30-$2.00 per research mission in LLM tokens (user's own API key), with the engine itself free under MIT license
BeHive uses dual-model extraction: Claude Haiku for bulk extraction, Sonnet for enriching thin claims
BeHive implements Jaccard 0.60 deduplication threshold to prevent same facts from different sources inflating counts
BeHive v0.2.0 was released on PyPI on July 28, 2026, with 26 GitHub stars and 6 forks
GPT-Researcher has 28,700+ stars and is the dominant open-source deep research tool, but lacks structured output and knowledge graphs
BeHive supports MCP (Model Context Protocol) natively via streamable-http transport on port 8090
BeHive integrates with Claude Desktop, Cursor, Windsurf, Hermes Agent, OpenClaw, n8n, and ChatGPT Custom GPTs
